title: Immunohistochemical Staining of Syndecan-1 in Human Pancreas Islet Beta Cells
author: Lora Starrs
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bmghk3t6
materials: Wipe around sections using tissue and incubate with 26 -52 μg/ml secondary HRP-rabbit anti-rat Ig (Dako; or alternative 30 μg/ml, Sigma) , 150 μl/section, for 30 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Deparaffinize and Rehydrate Slides
steps.instruction: Deparaffinize each slide in xylene for 1 min, then rehydrate by dipping 10 times in absolute ethanol, 10 times in 90 % ethanol, and 10 times in 70 % ethanol; finally wash slides in running tap water for 5 min.

steps.title: Prepare Slides for Staining
steps.instruction: Wipe around each tissue section with a tissue, encircle the section with a diamond pencil, and place the slide in a container holding 250 ml of tap water.

steps.title: Block Endogenous Peroxidase
steps.instruction: Incubate sections in 3 % hydrogen peroxide prepared in methanol (mix 25 ml: 30 % H₂O₂ + 225 ml methanol).

steps.title: Wash Slides Post-Peroxidase Block
steps.instruction: Wash slides twice for 2 min each in 250 ml phosphate‑buffered saline (PBS), then rinse in running tap water for 2–5 min.

steps.title: Prepare Citrate Antigen Retrieval Buffer
steps.instruction: Dissolve 1.05 g citric acid in 500 ml deionized water and adjust the pH to 6.0 using 2–10 M NaOH.

steps.title: Antigen Retrieval and Post‑Retrieval Wash
steps.instruction: Transfer slides to 250 ml citrate buffer and microwave at 1600 W: 2 min on high power, then two cycles of 6 min on low power; let slides cool on the bench for 30 min; finally wash slides in 250 ml PBS three times for 10 min each.

steps.title: Block Non‑Specific Binding
steps.instruction: Apply animal‑free blocking solution diluted to 20 % v/v with deionized water over the sections and incubate for 10 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Primary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Tip off excess block, wipe around sections, then add 125–150 µl per section of 50 µg/ml anti‑Sdc1 monoclonal antibody (or 50 µg/ml rat IgG2aκ isotype control) diluted in M.O.M. diluent; incubate at room temperature for 1 hour.

steps.title: Wash After Primary Antibody
steps.instruction: Wash slides with PBS, transfer to a container containing 250 ml PBS, and wash twice for 2 min each.

steps.title: Wash After Secondary Antibody
steps.instruction: After secondary antibody (not described) wash slides with PBS, place in a container with 250 ml PBS, and wash twice for 2 min each.

steps.title: Prepare AEC Chromogen Solution
steps.instruction: Mix 4.75 ml acetate buffer, 0.25 ml AEC stock solution, and 25 µl 3 % H₂O₂; filter through a disposable 0.2 µm filter, keep protected from light, refrigerate short‑term, and use within 2 hours.

substeps.instruction: Store protected from light, refrigerate, use ≤2 h

steps.title: Develop with AEC Solution
steps.instruction: Cover each section with the prepared AEC solution and incubate for 30 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash After AEC Development
steps.instruction: Wash off AEC solution with deionized water, transfer slides to a container with 250 ml deionized water, and wash three times for 10 min each.

steps.title: Counterstain, Wash, and Mount
steps.instruction: Lightly counterstain sections with Gill’s hematoxylin, wash in deionized water twice, briefly dip twice (2 sec each) in ammonium water (100 µl ammonia in 250 ml deionized water), wash again in deionized water twice (250 ml each), and coverslip using Glycergel mounting medium.

steps.title: Image and Analyze Stained Sections
steps.instruction: Capture images of the sections with a light microscope equipped with a camera; analyze the images in ImageJ using the color deconvolution plugin to calculate the percentage of islet area stained.
